fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human name for the arena singleton — the one walkable world the run plays out on. Source world/nagrand_arena.gd (NagrandArena).

fields.name: radius
fields.title: Arena radius (m)
fields.description: Walkable / collision radius of the near-black platform disc in metres. The disc and its collision cylinder share this edge, so spawns land on the platform. Source nagrand_arena.gd ARENA_RADIUS / PLATFORM_RADIUS (175.0).

fields.name: spawnRing
fields.title: Swarm spawn ring (m)
fields.description: Annular band of radii (from origin) the swarm spawns into each wave — far enough from the player's y=2 centre spawn to give reaction time, inside the rim so enemies stay on the disc. Source nagrand_arena.gd docstring 'swarm rings at ~60-100 around origin'.

fields.name: min
fields.title: Inner radius (m)
fields.description: Nearest spawn radius — no enemy spawns closer than this to the arena centre.

fields.name: max
fields.title: Outer radius (m)
fields.description: Farthest spawn radius — the outer edge of the swarm spawn band.

fields.name: rimRings
fields.title: Rim rings
fields.description: The three raised obsidian rim rings ringing the platform — climbable TorusMeshes whose tops form a height ladder for a sightline over the swarm. Ordered inner-to-outer / low-to-high. Each carries the ring node's world-y. Source nagrand_arena.gd RimRings (Ring0/1/2 node transforms in nagrand_arena.tscn).

fields.name: y
fields.title: Ring y (m)
fields.description: World-y position of this rim ring's node. Source nagrand_arena.tscn RimRings/Ring* transforms (-1.25 / 4.75 / 13.45).

fields.name: pillars
fields.title: Pillar count
fields.description: Number of emissive corner pillars (the Algiz-rune monolith companions) placed for scale. Source nagrand_arena.gd Pillars (Pillar0..Pillar3, four corners at ±30 XZ).

fields.name: lighting
fields.title: Lighting
fields.description: The single shadowed DirectionalLight3D 'Sun' that lights the disc (Mobile-renderer budget: one shadow caster). Fill / ambient / fog / bloom live in the Environment resource, not here. Source nagrand_arena.gd Sun (nagrand_arena.tscn).

fields.name: sunAngle
fields.title: Sun angle (deg)
fields.description: Dusk sun yaw the Sun DirectionalLight3D points from — a near-horizontal dusk rake (the shipped game pins dayTime ~0.95 in the Dusk->Night band). Derived from the Sun basis in nagrand_arena.tscn (~-51.4 deg).

fields.name: energy
fields.title: Sun energy
fields.description: light_energy of the Sun DirectionalLight3D — dim because dusk. Source nagrand_arena.tscn Sun.light_energy (0.5).
